sentences.text: Shri Avinash Zargar - Advocate for petitioner.

Shri Ritwik Parashar - Government Advocate for respondents/S
 Order

Petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India making following prayers :
"7.1.

That this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue an appropriate writ and quash the impugned orders dated 15.01.2021, Annexure P-1, 14.10.2015, Annexure P-8; and 10.02.2010, Annexure P-5; consequently the petitioner be granted permission to raise construction.

7.2 In the alternative the respondents may kindly be directed to acquire the plot of the petitioner and pay him compensation under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 Act within a reasonable time frame.

entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Suman Gaud vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Any other relief(s) which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit be also granted."
2. Petitioner has also filed contempt petition for willfully disobeying order dated 28.11.2022.
By said order, as an interim measure, it was directed that construction of road will not be made by respondents unless the land of petitioner is acquired.
3. It is submitted by counsel appearing for petitioner that respondents are proceeding to make construction over the land of petitioner.
4. Respondent No.2/contemnor is present before this Court.
He informed Court that no construction will be made on private land of petitioner till land is acquired and compensation is paid.

It is also submitted that proceedings will be completed within a period of 120 days.
5.
Government Advocate appearing for respondents/State assured that no rights of petitioner will be violated without following due procedure of law.

6. Heard the counsel for the parties.
7.

Considering aforesaid submissions made before this Court, writ petition as well as contempt petition are disposed off with directions to respondents to demarcate land of petitioner, which is to be used for purposes of construction of road.

Thereafter, compensation for acquisition of land is to be assessed as per Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and compensation be paid to petitioner.
Respondents are at liberty to enter into the land of petitioner for purposes of demarcation and assessing compensation.
Respondents are further directed to complete demarcation of land, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:50933 3 WP-1743-2021 assessment of compensation and its payment within a period of four months.

8. If petitioner is aggrieved by order of granting compensation, then she is at liberty to avail all remedies available to her under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
